description:
Embeds the query with Ollama (`nomic-embed-text`) and returns the closest public doc chunks
from the environment's search index (pgvector).

Source: GET /api/v1/docs/search
No Authorization header is required.
Prefer connection.workspaceName and connection.appId as stable config instead of generating identity fields dynamically.

appId.description: Optional secureFlows app id used as a default for hosted login tools

host.description: secureFlows base URL, for example https://api.example.com

workspaceName.description: Optional workspace name used as a default for tools that need it

limit.description: Maximum hits to return (server caps at 20)

name: get_docs_search
title: Semantic documentation search
